demo.scene.title: PLACEHOLDER: After Hours at the Records Annex
demo.scene.summary: PLACEHOLDER: two agents look for one missing file in a closed records annex. Scripted so nobody reaches 0 Health or 0 Sanity.
demo.place.annex.name: PLACEHOLDER Records Annex
demo.place.annex.text: PLACEHOLDER: a long room of grey cabinets under one working light. One cabinet is locked. The clerk's desk has a lamp and a cold cup of tea.
demo.place.corridor.name: PLACEHOLDER Service Corridor
demo.place.corridor.text: PLACEHOLDER: a narrow corridor behind the annex. A door at the far end is wrong in a way nobody can name: it is slightly too far away.
demo.beat.1.title: PLACEHOLDER Beat 1: Talk to the clerk
demo.beat.1.check: PLACEHOLDER: Persuasion, Cat-D. Handler-called. The Handler decides what success and failure mean; suggested: success, the clerk names the locked cabinet; failure, he stays quiet.
demo.beat.2.title: PLACEHOLDER Beat 2: Search the cabinets
demo.beat.2.check: PLACEHOLDER: Research, Cat-C. Handler-called. Suggested: success finds the file; on partial success the Handler may apply the Stunned condition by hand.
demo.beat.3.title: PLACEHOLDER Beat 3: Slip past the guard
demo.beat.3.check: PLACEHOLDER: Stealth, Cat-D. Handler-called. Suggested: on failure the Handler may enter a small damage amount of their choosing and apply the Bleeding condition by hand.
demo.beat.4.title: PLACEHOLDER Beat 4: The corridor door
demo.beat.4.check: PLACEHOLDER: Insight, Cat-C, to notice what is wrong with the door. The Handler calls the sanity loss from the Minor Supernatural Entity row (2 to 3) and enters it through the consequence review.

demo.phone.informant.2: PLACEHOLDER Informant: If you find it, don't read it in the corridor.
